title: Enrichment Fair Filter Permission Consistency

items.action: run enrichment without requiring optional fair discovery
discover and select fairs for the optional org-wide enrichment filter

migration.reason: Existing scraper execute and fair read permissions are reused.

backend.reason: Existing enrichment execution and fair lookup authorization remain unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; the fair lookup client already fails closed without fair_crm.fairs.read.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Enrichment route access and execution remain governed by scraper permissions; this change only gates optional fair discovery.

notes: Enrichment remains runnable with fair_crm.scraper.execute alone. On org-wide enrichment surfaces, the optional fair picker is shown only with fair_crm.fairs.read. If fair read is absent or is lost after a selection was made, selected fair ids are excluded from the outgoing enrichment request. Fair-scoped enrichment from an already-authorized fair detail is unchanged.
